title: Gérard Depardieu drops appeal against sexual assault conviction
summary_full: French actor apologises to two women he was convicted of assaulting on a film set in 2021The French actor Gérard Depardieu has dropped his appeal against a conviction for sexually assaulting two women on a film set, and has for the first time apologised to the victims.“I was found guilty. I hear it and I accept this conviction,” Depardieu, 77, said in a written statement. “I address my deep and sincere apologies to those who suffered.” Continue reading...
